title: Smooth perturbations of diagonally implicit Runge--Kutta methods
summary: A mixed accuracy framework for Runge--Kutta methods presented in [Grant, JSC 2022] has been shown to speed up the computation in diagonally implicit Runge--Kutta (DIRK) methods by using less expensive low accuracy approaches for the implicit stages. This theory included both smooth and nonsmooth perturbations, and subsequent work focused primarily on the case of nonsmooth perturbations that arise from mixed precision simulations.
